List available policy components

Source: R/policies.R
available_policies.Rd

Returns the policy groups, aggregation metrics, slope branches, and materialized policy definitions available from the policy registry.

Usage

available_policies(policy_path = NULL)

Arguments

policy_path

Optional path to a policy registry JSON file.

Value

A named list with groups, metrics, branches, and policies tibbles.

Examples

available_policies()
